campaign.name: Credo Legal — Competitive v1 (Meta)
campaign.notes: Consumer-debt ads require the CREDIT Special Ad Category (no age/gender/ZIP targeting, limited detailed targeting, location radius >= 15 miles). Launch PAUSED; QA before spend.

targeting_defaults.note: Ads are New York only (decided 23 Sep). Every disclaimer is the NY attorney-advertising disclaimer; do not extend to other states without new compliance review.

utm.note: Paste the url_parameters value into Ads Manager > Ad > Tracking > URL parameters (or use full_link as the website URL). utm_content identifies the ad and its creative version.

placement_plan.on_hold: 9:16 — 16 of 18 static 9:16 banners and the videos' burned-in strip put the disclaimer in the bottom 20% of the frame, which Stories/Reels cover with the CTA. Do not upload 9:16 until they are moved.

compliance.in_primary_text: Every primary text ends with the NY disclaimer; do not edit or shorten it.
compliance.in_creative: Every image carries the NY disclaimer; videos carry the AI-performer disclosure strip.
before_launch: Responsible attorney pre-approves every ad (NY Rule 7.1(k)).
Keep a copy of each ad for at least one year.
Confirm the New York entity name (Credo Legal Services, P.C.).

ads.primary_text:
Getting collection calls about a debt you're not sure you owe?

Before you pay a cent, you can make the collector validate the debt in writing. Many collectors, especially debt buyers, can't produce the paperwork to back it up.

Our attorneys review what they send and tell you where you stand.

Attorney Advertising. Credo Legal Services, P.C., 1 Liberty Street, Suite 4010, New York, NY 10006. (212) 461-4026. Image is a dramatization. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.
ads.headline: Make Collectors Prove Before You Pay
ads.description: Free case review. Flat monthly fee.
